system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: instantiate N domain reviewers from the project gatekeeper core + a generated domain overlay
system_prompt_style.note: Skill loaded into Claude Code host; reviewer prompts composed from core + generated overlay; SKILL.md not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: split manuscript (LaTeX or Markdown) into reading units, the canonical section list, and stable `passage-id`s (which prevent text drift and give jurors local context)
env_context_strategy.note: Deterministic decomposition injects units/section list; jurors get on-demand context expansion; host Claude Code navigates.

context_compaction.note: Context handled by host Claude Code; per-round fresh reviewers avoid prior history (isolation), not compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: parallelism plus schema-validated output by construction
observation_format.note: Scripts return JSON (e.g. --json); Read-on-PDF may add images via host.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The **deterministic guards in `scripts/`** run orchestrator-side via Bash between workflow calls.
tool_call_format.note: Inherits Claude Code host tool calling; guards invoked as shell commands.

tool_count.note: Skill defines no tool schema of its own; tools come from Claude Code host (Bash, Workflow, Agent/Task).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: atomic apply + journal of a drafted patch; exact-once guard on `before` text
edit_primitive.note: apply-patch.js replaces exact `before` text; host editing tools also available.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool schemas provided by host Claude Code.

protocol_standardization.note: No protocol mention in evidence; host may support MCP.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The courtroom engine is `assign-reviewers → reading-check → coverage-auditor → merge → {trial ‖ polish} → recall-audit → drafter → {edit-audit | meaning-audit} → clerk`.
loop_primitives.note: Default review mode runs one pipeline round; auto mode loops review-revise until clerk convergence; jury multi-voter selection.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: `LEDGER.json` resolved at runtime = the machine source of truth, plus a rendered `LEDGER.md` view
planning_granularity.note: Ledger of issues + frozen spine.json persisted and re-read across rounds.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: spawn the **same** N reviewers / jurors as **parallel `Agent`/`Task` subagents in a single message**, each with the same ISOLATED prompt
multi_agent_topology.note: Orchestrator fans out reviewers, 5/12 jurors, judge; direct-edit mode is single.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: spawn the **same** N reviewers / jurors as **parallel `Agent`/`Task` subagents in a single message**

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Never edit the manuscript without explicit author sign-off.
human_in_loop.note: Default: per-patch sign-off; auto mode uses up-front spine/reviewer-assignment sign-off plus return queue.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: JSON ledger plus MD view; **gate = `/goal` completion fact**

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: **Claude memory**: the active project's memory: stable conventions worth recalling next session (this paper's house style, venue, persona tuning).
long_term_memory.note: Ledger persists across sessions; itself a Claude Code skill.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
if a `.paper-review/` working copy AND a ledger exist, REUSE them, never
re-extract
state_persistence.note: Ledger is live issue state across rounds and sessions.

self_verification.evidence_quote: a deterministic majority verdict (quorum reached, one side >60%) + a judge that routes a decided-valid charge
self_verification.note: compile-guard LaTeX compile/lint; edit-audit/meaning-audit; direct-edit logic-check self-check.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: `review` stops at the human gates and does not auto-advance.
retry_policy.note: Auto mode (opt-in via /goal) repeats rounds until gate passes or hard limit (until_pass); ultracode maxRounds:4.

rollback.note: apply-patch.js revert; drift -> revert + queue. Closest value per per-edit history.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
Termination:
clerk convergence (primary) OR applied-quiescence (K dry rounds) OR a hard limit.
termination_condition.note: Auto mode; gate check is deterministic ledger fact (mapped to test_pass). Review mode ends after one round.

cost_controls.note: Fast mode is TODO; bounded generation noted but no budget cap.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: all deterministic guards run orchestrator-side via Bash between workflow calls.
execution_isolation.note: Workflow sandbox has no fs/subprocess; host Claude Code environment.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Your project files, ledger, journal, and patches stay inside your local paper project.

network_policy.evidence_quote: if GitHub is unreachable, it stays silent and continues.

permission_model.evidence_quote: it drafts the change, self-checks it, shows you the patch, and applies it after you approve.
permission_model.note: Manuscript edits gated per patch; auto mode uses pre-authorized policy (edit-safety risk rules).

replayability.note: Journal supports revert, no replay mechanism described.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: **Validation of the engine on real papers at scale.**
eval_hooks.note: Listed as roadmap; only dogfood sample and unit tests.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Safe fixes land under risk-proportional safety (frozen anchors, a per-passage edit cap, an anchor and cross-section meaning audit), always behind your sign-off.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A pre-submission AI review stress-test for research papers.

open_source.note: LICENSE file present but not shown.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: It is a Claude Code skill, installable two ways.
